subject: Microgrant request — condensed onboarding + usage plan
messages:
From: Anita Kapoor <anita@launchgrid.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short-form microgrant for accelerator cohort

Hi Laura,

LaunchGrid is finalizing our next pre-seed accelerator (cohort starts 12/6) and we have a last-minute ask from three teams that need a lightweight credits package to run LLM experiments during onboarding. We previously ran a larger pilot with Redwood and loved the throughput/latency — so we'd rather keep this small and simple than spin up new infrastructure.

Request: a 3-week microgrant (USD-equivalent credits) mapped to sandbox access + one dedicated onboarding session. No long commitment required. The accelerator team wants something that is easy to accept in our platform (procurement is light if the terms are simple).

Key constraints:
- Each team: ~50k tokens/week usage estimate (rapid prototyping, embeddings + small generations).
- Must be usable immediately (Dec 1) and expire end of cohort (Dec 31).
- We need a short agreement or voucher code — procurement prefers a voucher flow or a one-page MSA addendum.

Is there a condensed onboarding/microgrant package you can propose? Happy to share the three teams' basic profiles if that helps.

Thanks,
Anita Kapoor
Director, Accelerator Programs
LaunchGrid Labs
Anita@launchgrid.ai

---
Note: procurement contact: procure@launchgrid.ai
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Anita Kapoor <anita@launchgrid.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short-form microgrant for accelerator cohort

Hi Anita,

Thanks for the note — glad to hear the pilot went well. We can support a condensed microgrant program with a voucher flow so procurement can accept quickly. To keep things operationally light, here's what I propose: 

Proposal (condensed microgrant):
- Voucher allocation: 3 vouchers, each worth USD 150 in hosted credits, valid 2027-12-01 through 2027-12-31.
- Sandbox access provisioned through one shared onboarding project per team.
- Single onboarding workshop (90 minutes) led by our Developer Success engineer.
- No long-term commitment; voucher can be converted to Dedicated trial if teams convert to paid within 60 days (conversion credit applies).

Operational notes:
- We'll issue vouchers via our console and can attach a one-page Terms Addendum that procurement can sign.
- For use-cases with heavier embedding needs, we can recommend an embedding-only profile with lower per-embedding unit cost.

I've looped in Ben (pricing lead) and Olga (partner ops) to confirm pricing guardrails and whether we should offer any additional promo for cohort-wide demos. Could you confirm the three teams' projected usage (simple table: team name, primary use, weekly token estimate)? If procurement wants a voucher + DocuSign link, we can generate that once terms are approved.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: none (we'll prepare voucher terms once you confirm)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Anita Kapoor <anita@launchgrid.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short-form microgrant for accelerator cohort

Laura / Anita — quick follow.

Thanks Laura, proposal looks good. A couple of notes from pricing/ops side:

1) Voucher sizing: USD 150 per team should be fine given the usage profile, but let's make the voucher refundable back to credits only if converted to a paid account within 60 days (standard conversion uplift: 20% credit match).

2) Cohort promo: For demo day we can offer a single cohort-wide promo code for 10% off first month on Dedicated if at least one team converts. That is optional and contingent on approval from growth.

3) Compliance/terms: Olga, can you attach the condensed microgrant addendum (one-pager) and the onboarding MOP (method-of-provisioning) spreadsheet? We should keep the addendum language minimal: voucher codes, validity dates, permitted use, and liability cap. Procurement will like the voucher flow.

Anita — I'll draft the DocuSign envelope once we finalize the one-pager. Attaching a stub: microgrant_terms_v1.pdf and onboarding_mop.xlsx to this chain for visibility (internal draft).

-Ben

Ben Carter
Head of Growth Partnerships
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Laura / Ben / Olga — thanks, this is exactly the kind of simple flow procurement asked for.

We confirm the three teams and their basic usage (sent separately to your portal). Procurement approves the voucher flow but will require the one-page addendum signed by LaunchGrid's director and Redwood. I copied procure@launchgrid.ai so they can handle the signature logistics.

Next steps we need from Redwood:
- Finalize the one-page microgrant addendum (we reviewed your draft, a couple minor wording tweaks — procurement will comment inline on the DocuSign).
- Generate the three voucher codes and the DocuSign link.
- Schedule the 90-minute onboarding session during week of Dec 1 (we prefer the morning PST).

If you can send the DocuSign link and vouchers by Monday 11/29 EOD PST, we'll sign and distribute to teams. Appreciate you making this lightweight.

Best,
Anita Kapoor
Director, Accelerator Programs
LaunchGrid Labs
